brief: The canvas presents an abstract, high-altitude view of a vast, illuminated cityscape. The dominant visual elements are soft, flowing streaks of colored light that drift across the dark backdrop, suggesting the kinetic energy of a sprawling metropolis. These streams of light constantly move and interact with one another. At irregular intervals, the intersecting flow of streaks momentarily stabilizes, creating sharper, angular geometric forms—polygons and bursts of light—that briefly overlay the smooth, liquid movement. The composition is entirely dynamic, always in motion, capturing the vibrant and evolving energy of the urban landscape.
